method: Nelder-Mead on log-parameters, sum of squared standardised residuals (data/calibration/targets.json)

targets.note: Col-0 seed ABA decreases by 70% within 12 h of imbibition (Results text); Kushiro 2004: half-time about 6 h, basal after 12 h
Col-0 testa rupture 20-31 h after sowing at 22 C (Dekkers 2013); first embryo expansion concurrent with visible testa rupture at 16-22 HAI (Bassel 2014)
expansion phase driving endosperm rupture 28-32 HAI (Bassel 2014); population endosperm rupture 31-45 h (Dekkers 2013)
first cell expansion in the lower hypocotyl between 16 and 22 HAI; onset = first hour any cortical cell at index 5-12 exceeds 1.05x its 3 h volume

targets.unit: cortical cell index from the QC
targets.note: relative expansion greatest around cell number 8 (collet); evaluated at endosperm rupture, relative to 3 h
Lepidium endosperm cap puncture force ~38 mN early, 50% endosperm rupture at ~23 mN (Linkies et al. 2010, Fig. 1): ratio ~0.6 (proxy species)
